entities.name: Finansinspektionen (FI, Swedish FSA)
entities.description: Sweden's competent authority under MiCA. As of 30 Jun 2026 Safello AB was the only crypto-asset service provider authorised by FI, while 77 firms authorised in other EU countries may serve Swedish consumers. FI refused QB Europe AB (Valuno group) and Ijort Invest AB (GreenMerc group); both appealed. The MiCA transitional period in Sweden ended on 30 Jun 2026.

caveats: ESMA's interim MiCA register is a CSV snapshot (checked 3 Oct 2026); national registers may be more up to date.
Sweden: ministers are not listed while a new government is being formed after the September 2026 election.
Private-sector people outside Norway are only included where a public source names their role (so far only Virtune's CEO). More will be added by the researcher with sources.
Legal entity identifiers, organisation numbers and addresses from the registers are deliberately left out.

rejected.reason: Rejected (editor rule: licence must cover the country): Binance has no MiCA authorisation and, per Kaupr, stopped serving new EU customers from 1 July 2026; the Swedish AB alone does not make it a licensed Nordic service.
